name: portfolio
description: Portfolio monorepo: Nuxt 4 frontend + Strapi 5 CMS

scripts.dev: concurrently -n strapi,nuxt -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:strapi" "npm run dev:nuxt"
scripts.build: npm run build:strapi && npm run build:nuxt
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix strapi && npm install --prefix nuxt
